Physical reference only: calm-water, clean-hull corrected delivered propeller power, not validated measured shaft power. Loading comparisons are retrospective; incompatible engine references and unknown Noon timing prevent automatic correction.

Daily Ridge error; plotted days require at least 30 observed labels. Positive panels are retrospective subsets; broader-forward includes recorded-zero states. All days and missing-truth coverage remain in the tables.

Fixed historical model definitions before/after adding August. Positive panels are retrospective target-conditioned subsets; broader-forward panels preserve zero/negative truths. Previously inspected September/October development; no universal winner.

Retrospective recorded-zero diagnostic. Zeros are observed and quality-uncertain, not confirmed missing or physical disengagement. October has only 12 zero observations; it cannot support a reliable zero-state performance claim.

Fixed and conditional label-assisted scenarios use different information. Assisted methods assume trustworthy labels, at least 24h delay and daily refresh. Positive panels are retrospective subsets. Match assisted methods against delayed persistence/history mean; retain September transition failures.

All scheduled original 24h gap blocks remain present; blank errors mean unscoreable forward truth. This retrospective reconstruction simulation assumes independent inputs survive and historical labels meet the stated delay. Zero states remain uncertain.

Original V7 durations use different calendar/operating samples, so the curve is not a causal gap-duration effect. Positive panels are retrospective target-conditioned subsets. Historical-label availability and independent-input survival are conditional.

Historical-risk acceptance is not a confidence guarantee. Accepted-zero groups are retrospective target-conditioned subsets: all their errors exceed the early q95 reference. Accepted-positive accuracy alone would conceal severe failures.

Paired anchors, common 24h embargo and identical prediction prefixes. Different horizons contain different operating minutes and missing-truth coverage; no causal duration claim. Retrospective development simulation; persistence outperforms tested calibration broadly, but still fails transitions.

Four previously inspected failure cases, not a representative accuracy sample. Retrospective label-state diagnostics; early-fold safeguards cannot certify current state. Accepted August zero errors and positive recovery errors remain included.
